svg.text: Modern AI, end to end — a concept map in school-and-apprentice terms

Each box gives the technical name, then the same idea as a pupil, a teacher, a book, or an exam in one school that grows into a workplace. Read the bands top to bottom, oldest ideas first; follow the arrows to see
what made what possible. Dates in the captions are when each idea became mainstream, not when it was first written down. State of play as of September 2026.
1 · THE FIRST PUPIL · how a network learns anything at all · 1943–2011
2 · LEARNING TO SEE AND TO READ · the deep learning decade · 2012–2016
3 · READING THE WHOLE PAGE AT ONCE · the Transformer (2017) · every band below is built on the wide box
4 · READING THE WHOLE LIBRARY · pretraining and scale · 2018–2022
5 · TEACHING MANNERS · alignment and the chat assistant · 2022–2023
6 · MORE THAN WORDS · multimodal models and generative media · 2020–2025
7 · THINKING BEFORE ANSWERING · reasoning models and test-time compute · 2022–2026
8 · GIVING IT HANDS · retrieval, tools, and agents · 2023–2026
9 · KEEPING IT CHEAP AND FAST · inference and efficiency · 2022–2026
10 · THE UNSOLVED HOMEWORK · what is still open, as of September 2026
